audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — the two layers disagreed on five of seven rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[] exactly, and 53.59% over 1366 games supports Hwei-favoured early (Brand cannot stun without a prior ablaze application) with a genuine skill-check band at 4-6 when both ults are up.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Hwei, phases[3..4].side stay Skill, phases[5..6].side = Hwei. The two Skill rows had Hwei-favoured whys, so both were rewritten to even framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] said the first item scales both champions "roughly evenly" while win[5] awarded the row to Hwei — the row argued with the sentence under it. spikes[1] named Brand's ultimate "Conflagration (his R)".
audit.why: Conflagration is Brand's E (625 range, 13/12/11/10/9). His ultimate is Pyroclasm, 750 range, 100/90/80, bouncing up to 5 times. Hwei's R is 1300 range, so the first-item siege window is genuinely his.
audit.corrected: whys[5] now states the range reason the row belongs to Hwei; spikes[1] names Pyroclasm with its real bounce count and 100s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only obliquely, and Hwei's own abilities were misnamed throughout: "EE fear" (the fear is Grim Visage on EQ), "W charm/root" and "W terrain/zone" (Hwei's W paints are Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights — no charm, no root, no terrain), "E-Q poke" and "QA" clears.
audit.why: Riot's text: "If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target." The stun therefore requires a prior Blaze application — Pillar of Flame (900 range, delayed) or Conflagration (625 range, targeted). Dodge the applier and the stun is only damage. ownerKit lists E sub-abilities Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw in EQ/EW/EE order and Q sub-abilities Devastating Fire / Severing Bolt / Molten Fissure in QQ/QW/QE order.
audit.corrected: Named the real chain: stay unlit and Sear cannot stun; Pillar of Flame is the 10s opener and lands on a delay; Conflagration doubles its spread on a burning target and only reaches 625 units, so he must walk into your paint to use it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and packet.defects flags that this matchup has zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues: 0).
audit.why: Brand's whole pattern is cooldown-gated: Sear 8s at rank 1 to 6s at rank 5, Pillar of Flame 10s to 8s, Conflagration 13s to 9s, Pyroclasm 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[1].d now carry the real numbers and a "wait for X before you Y" line: with Pillar of Flame down for 10 seconds he has only a 625-range Conflagration, which is the step-up window.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). winCon and dosFull[2].d both cited a "fifteen-second" window that matches nothing in Brand's kit.
audit.why: No Brand ability is on 15 seconds at any rank; his longest non-ultimate is Conflagration at 13s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Invented figure removed from both fields; bodies rewritten to match their titles.
